description: This file contains unit tests for the AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesBusinessStep class in the Fineract project, specifically testing the execution logic for adding periodic accruals to loan accounts during the close of business steps.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesBusinessStepTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesBusinessStep, testing execution, exception handling, and name retrieval methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes context and the object under test before each test case.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test.

methods.name: givenLoanWithAccrual
methods.description: Verifies that calling execute on a loan triggers the addPeriodicAccruals method once.

methods.name: givenLoanWithAccrualThrowException
methods.description: Tests that an exception during accrual processing is properly caught and wrapped into a BusinessStepException.

methods.name: testGetEnumStyledNameSuccessScenario
methods.description: Tests that the enum-styled name of the step is as expected.

methods.name: testGetHumanReadableNameSuccessScenario
methods.description: Tests that the human-readable name of the step is as expected.
